note: Captured once from published effect-dynamodb 1.39.0 on DynamoDB Local. Never regenerate it.
describes: Published effect-dynamodb@1.39.0 and @effect-dynamodb/schema@1.39.0 with effect@4.1.2. One table on DynamoSchema { name: rx, version: 1 } holding the entity SoftU: model { id: String, f: Duration }, primary key pk [id] / sk [f], softDelete: true, unique byF: [f], index byF (gsi1: pk [id], sk [f]). After put { id: a, f: Duration.millis(1500) }, a soft delete and a restore of that item, every row: the item restored under f_[object object] with its index key, the sentinel the restore wrote under [object object], and the one put wrote, which the soft delete didn't release.
